intent: Finance charts on the overview: monthly inflow vs outflow (bar) + outflow by category (pie) per finance.md contract, finance.read only, with loading skeletons and empty states.
summary: Implemented PSI-106. Pure aggregation in src/features/finance/overview-lib.ts: aggregateFinanceOverview computes monthly inflow/outflow (last 6 months, zero-filled, decimal strings) and outflow by category (top 5 + Other, sum preserved). Server action getFinanceOverviewAction in finance/actions.ts: gated requirePermission('finance.read'), fetches last 6 months of finance_entries with RLS, feeds overview-lib. UI: OverviewFinanceGraphs (overview-finance-graphs.tsx) renders recharts BarChart (inflow/outflow with custom tooltips, empty state) + PieChart (outflow by category, legend with formatIDR, empty state); FinanceOverviewSkeleton (finance-overview-skeleton.tsx) matches bar+pie loading shapes. Integrated as a Next.js parallel slot @finance with page/loading/default/error; layout.tsx reads session, evaluates canReadFinance and conditionally mounts the slot after the demo charts. Non-finance readers see no finance section or charts. 4 unit tests in overview-lib.test.ts. Gates: 60/60 frontend, 15/15 edge fns, tsc clean, oxlint 0/0.

changes.note: pure aggregation: monthly inflow/outflow + outflow by category (top 5 + Other)
4 unit tests: zero-filling, monthly math, top N + Other slicing
recharts BarChart (inflow vs outflow) + PieChart (outflow by category) + empty states
parallel slot page: finance.read session check + fetch
async layout, getSession, canReadFinance gate, mounts @finance slot

decisions.decision: Extracted aggregation to overview-lib.ts as a pure function
decisions.reason: Allows fast unit testing of zero-filling, decimal-string formatting, and top N + Other category slicing without mocking supabase or server-only.

decisions.decision: Integrated as a Next.js parallel slot @finance in the overview layout
decisions.reason: Matches the existing @area_stats/@bar_stats/@pie_stats/@sales slot architecture in src/app/dashboard/overview/ with independent loading.tsx and error.tsx boundaries.

decisions.decision: Layout reads session and conditionally mounts {finance} only when canReadFinance
decisions.reason: Users without finance.read never see the charts container or empty state, preserving the privacy contract at both the UI and data layer.

verification.manual: bun test src/ 60/60 (4 new overview-lib tests), bun test supabase/functions 15/15, tsc --noEmit clean, oxlint 0 warnings 0 errors.

follow_ups.note: Visual browser check of the overview finance charts with seeded entries once the dev server is run with admin@p3md.test.
